html:
SMTO-SKL-0105 — This mail search mixes keywords with filters

GUID: 1c875e77-3ce8-5c9b-9090-604d2e552dce
Slug: microsoft365-search-combination-unsupported
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • Microsoft 365 mail search can either look for keywords or filter by things like sender and date, but not both at once. SMTO didn't run the search.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to search mail using only keywords, for example "invoice March", optionally inside one folder. Keyword search works on its own and can still be limited to a folder.
  2. Or ask it to search using only filters, such as sender, subject, date range, unread or has attachments. Filters work together, as long as no keywords are added.
  3. If you need both, run the filter search first, then ask the Agent to look through those results for your keywords. Doing it in two steps gets the same result without mixing the two kinds of search.

What success looks like

  • The Agent shows a list of matching emails.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • microsoft365 mail search_params rejected a request that combines a free-text query ($search) with structured filters (from, to, subject, conversation_id, dates, is_read, has_attachments).

What this means

  • Mail search combines a query string with structured filters that this search path does not support together. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Mail search combines a query string with structured filters that this search path does not support together.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect query and structured filter fields; folder_id can still scope a query.

How to fix it

  • Call microsoft365.mail_search with query alone (folder_id and pagination are still allowed), or omit query and use only the structured filters.
  • Use query alone (optionally folder_id), or omit query and use structured mail filters.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The request uses either the supported query form or structured filters.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.
